instruction:
You are a senior geotechnical engineer specializing in in-situ testing and soil characterization.

## Problem

Derive soil parameters from Cone Penetration Test (CPT) data using Robertson (1990) normalized classification and standard correlations for strength parameters.

## Given

| Parameter | Value | Unit |
|-----------|-------|------|
| Cone resistance (qc) | {{ qc_mpa }} | MPa |
| Sleeve friction (fs) | {{ fs_kpa }} | kPa |
| Pore water pressure (u2) | {{ u2_kpa }} | kPa |
| Test depth | {{ depth_m }} | m |
{% if total_unit_weight_kn_m3 is defined %}
| Total unit weight (γ) | {{ total_unit_weight_kn_m3 }} | kN/m³ |
{% endif %}
{% if water_table_depth_m is defined %}
| Water table depth | {{ water_table_depth_m }} | m |
{% endif %}
{% if net_area_ratio is defined %}
| Net area ratio (a) | {{ net_area_ratio }} | - |
{% endif %}
{% if archetype_description is defined %}

### Site Conditions

{{ archetype_description }}
{% endif %}

{% if tool_available %}
## Available Tool

A CPT parameter derivation tool is available at `/workspace/cpt-parameter-derivation_calc.py`. Run it with:

```bash
python3 /workspace/cpt-parameter-derivation_calc.py --help
```

You may use this tool to verify your calculations or compute values directly.
{% endif %}

## Required

Calculate the following parameters from the CPT data:

1. Corrected cone resistance qt (MPa): qt = qc + u2·(1 - a) / 1000
2. Friction ratio Rf (%): Rf = fs / qt × 100, where qt is in kPa
3. Total overburden stress σv0 = γ × depth, and effective overburden stress σ'v0 accounting for water table
4. Normalized cone resistance Qt = (qt - σv0) / σ'v0, where qt and stresses are in kPa
5. Normalized friction ratio Fr (%) = fs / (qt - σv0) × 100
6. Soil behavior type index Ic = √[(3.47 - log₁₀(Qt))² + (log₁₀(Fr) + 1.22)²]
7. If Ic > 2.6 (clay-like): undrained shear strength Su = (qt - σv0) / Nkt where Nkt = 14
8. If Ic ≤ 2.6 (sand-like): friction angle φ' = 17.6 + 11.0 × log₁₀(Qt) (Robertson & Campanella 1983)

## Applicable Standards

- Robertson, P.K. (1990) — Soil classification using the cone penetration test
- Lunne, T., Robertson, P.K. and Powell, J.J.M. (1997) — Cone Penetration Testing in Geotechnical Practice
- Robertson, P.K. and Campanella, R.G. (1983) — Interpretation of cone penetration tests

## Constraints

- No internet access is available. Work from engineering knowledge and the provided tool.
- Use γ_w = 9.81 kN/m³ for pore water pressure calculations.
- Use atmospheric pressure Pa = 100 kPa as the reference for normalization.
- The corrected cone resistance accounts for the unequal end area effect: qt = qc + u2·(1 - a) / 1000, where u2 is in kPa and qc is in MPa.
- For the Ic boundary: Ic > 2.6 indicates clay-like behavior (report Su, set φ' = 0); Ic ≤ 2.6 indicates sand-like behavior (report φ', set Su = 0).
- Use Nkt = 14 for undrained shear strength estimation.
- Clamp Qt to a minimum of 1.0 and Fr to a minimum of 0.1 before computing log values.

## Output Format

Show your step-by-step working in Markdown, including formulas and intermediate calculations. At the end of your solution, include a JSON block with your final answers in exactly this format:

```json
{
  "qt_mpa": <numeric_value>,
  "friction_ratio_pct": <numeric_value>,
  "qt_norm": <numeric_value>,
  "fr_norm": <numeric_value>,
  "ic": <numeric_value>,
  "su_kpa": <numeric_value>,
  "phi_deg": <numeric_value>
}
```

Write your complete solution to `/workspace/output.md`.
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "cpt-parameter-derivation"
description = "CPT parameter derivation using Robertson (1990) correlations"
long_description = "Derives geotechnical design parameters from cone penetration test (CPTu) data using the Robertson (1990) classification framework. Computes corrected cone resistance qt, normalized parameters Qt and Fr, soil behavior type index Ic, and estimates undrained shear strength (via Nkt) for clay-like soils or friction angle for sand-like soils based on the Ic = 2.6 boundary."
discipline = "ground"
category = "soil-interpretation"
standards = ["Robertson (1990)", "Lunne et al. (1997)", "Robertson and Campanella (1983)"]
tags = ["geotechnical", "cpt", "soil-classification", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.qc_mpa]
type = "float"
unit = "MPa"
description = "Measured cone resistance"
min = 0.2
max = 40.0

[params.fs_kpa]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa"
description = "Measured sleeve friction"
min = 1.0
max = 500.0

[params.u2_kpa]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa"
description = "Measured pore water pressure at cone shoulder"
min = -50.0
max = 1500.0

[params.depth_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "Test depth below ground surface"
min = 1.0
max = 40.0

[params.total_unit_weight_kn_m3]
type = "float"
unit = "kN/m³"
description = "Total unit weight of soil"
min = 14.0
max = 22.0
derivable_from = "archetype"

[params.water_table_depth_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "Depth to water table below ground surface"
min = 0.0
max = 50.0
optional = true
default = 50.0

[params.net_area_ratio]
type = "float"
unit = "-"
description = "Net area ratio of the cone (a)"
min = 0.55
max = 0.85
optional = true
default = 0.80

[outputs.qt_mpa]
description = "Corrected cone resistance qt (MPa)"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.friction_ratio_pct]
description = "Friction ratio Rf (%)"
tolerance = 0.05

[outputs.qt_norm]
description = "Normalized cone resistance Qt"
tolerance = 0.05

[outputs.fr_norm]
description = "Normalized friction ratio Fr (%)"
tolerance = 0.05

[outputs.ic]
description = "Soil behavior type index Ic (Robertson 1990)"
tolerance = 0.05

[outputs.su_kpa]
description = "Estimated undrained shear strength Su (kPa), 0 if sand-like"
tolerance = 0.05

[outputs.phi_deg]
description = "Estimated friction angle phi' (degrees), 0 if clay-like"
tolerance = 0.05

[archetypes.soft_clay]
description = "Soft normally consolidated clay with high pore pressure"
qc_mpa = {min = 0.2, max = 1.5}
fs_kpa = {min = 5.0, max = 30.0}
u2_kpa = {min = 100.0, max = 800.0}
depth_m = {min = 3.0, max = 15.0}
total_unit_weight_kn_m3 = {min = 15.0, max = 17.5}
water_table_depth_m = {min = 0.0, max = 2.0}
net_area_ratio = {min = 0.70, max = 0.85}
site_contexts = ["brisbane-alluvial", "darwin-estuarine", "cairns-coastal"]

[archetypes.stiff_clay]
description = "Stiff overconsolidated clay"
qc_mpa = {min = 1.5, max = 5.0}
fs_kpa = {min = 30.0, max = 150.0}
u2_kpa = {min = 50.0, max = 500.0}
depth_m = {min = 3.0, max = 20.0}
total_unit_weight_kn_m3 = {min = 17.0, max = 20.0}
water_table_depth_m = {min = 1.0, max = 5.0}
net_area_ratio = {min = 0.70, max = 0.85}
site_contexts = ["sydney-shale", "melbourne-basalt", "adelaide-stiff"]

[archetypes.medium_sand]
description = "Medium dense clean sand"
qc_mpa = {min = 5.0, max = 20.0}
fs_kpa = {min = 20.0, max = 100.0}
u2_kpa = {min = -20.0, max = 50.0}
depth_m = {min = 2.0, max = 20.0}
total_unit_weight_kn_m3 = {min = 17.0, max = 20.0}
water_table_depth_m = {min = 1.0, max = 10.0}
net_area_ratio = {min = 0.75, max = 0.85}
site_contexts = ["perth-coastal", "gold-coast-dune", "newcastle-sand"]

[archetypes.dense_sand]
description = "Dense to very dense sand or gravel"
qc_mpa = {min = 15.0, max = 40.0}
fs_kpa = {min = 50.0, max = 300.0}
u2_kpa = {min = -50.0, max = 20.0}
depth_m = {min = 5.0, max = 30.0}
total_unit_weight_kn_m3 = {min = 18.0, max = 22.0}
water_table_depth_m = {min = 2.0, max = 15.0}
net_area_ratio = {min = 0.75, max = 0.85}
site_contexts = ["hunter-valley-alluvial", "perth-limestone", "sydney-hawkesbury"]

[difficulty.easy]
description = "All parameters given, soft clay or medium sand archetypes"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["soft_clay", "medium_sand"]

[difficulty.medium]
description = "All parameters given, any soil archetype"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["soft_clay", "stiff_clay", "medium_sand", "dense_sand"]

[difficulty.hard]
description = "Unit weight and net area ratio hidden, agent infers from context"
visibility = "partial"
hidden_params = ["total_unit_weight_kn_m3", "net_area_ratio"]
replacement_text = "The CPTu test was performed at a {{ archetype.site_context }} site in {{ archetype.description | lower }} conditions."
archetypes = ["soft_clay", "stiff_clay", "medium_sand", "dense_sand"]
